data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Peri was a divine being associated with light, illumination, and the brightness of the sun. In Christianity, the term 'peri' can refer to those who are 'around' or 'near' the faith, or the 'pericope', a passage from the Scriptures read in church. The name Peri carries the meaning “Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Peri usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
